user_goal: Correct the independently confirmed release-proof gaps and continue until Plotkeeper is public and ready for use.

authority.verbatim_text: approved and authorized.  You are hereby authorized and approved to perform any and all actions in regards to plotkeeper that allow you to continue until PK is on git, sharable and ready for public use

baseline.protection_evidence: Clean candidate independently reviewed PARTIAL with exactly two proof defects and no product/runtime defect.
baseline.selection_reason: Last candidate before correcting the server receipt-chain verifier and rollback baseline.

semantic_changes: Require a complete candidate-bound phase receipt chain with authority, obligations, evidence bindings, delegation, diff hash, target digest, and independent reviewer flags.
Align rollback to the protected enforcement baseline using force-with-lease.
Configure origin and continue the reviewed release process.
Do not change Plotkeeper runtime, hook implementation/trust, installer, attribution, licensing, or unrelated documentation.
Do not weaken any verifier check or manufacture phase evidence.
Do not push without a new independent DEPLOY_READY PASS for the exact corrected candidate.

invariants: A fabricated minimal receipt fails server verification.
Only a complete independently sealed VALIDATED to MERGE_READY to DEPLOY_READY chain for the exact candidate passes.
Rollback targets bf5b9978f166d8c612b164c5908dd8fe12135d2a or the reviewer-approved corrected baseline and uses force-with-lease.
The public target remains empty before authorized push.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Server verification rejects incomplete, fabricated, replayed, or mismatched release evidence and accepts only the complete independent phase chain.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Headline-only receipts, missing authority, missing obligations, missing predecessors, or mismatched diff/target may not pass.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Rollback and remote configuration are exact and ready before release.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Rollback may not point to an obsolete baseline or use an unqualified force push.

proof_requirements.claim: Every required receipt and evidence field is enforced.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Test omissions and mutations across authority, obligations, predecessors, diff, delegation, reviewer flags, and target digest.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Each omission or mutation fails and a complete exact chain passes.

proof_requirements.claim: The GitHub workflow supplies the sealed chain without tracked-receipt circularity.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Inspect variable bundle parsing and exact candidate binding.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: The immutable reviewer chain is supplied out of band and binds the pushed SHA.

proof_requirements.claim: Origin and rollback are correct before push.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Inspect origin URL and lease-bound rollback baseline.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Origin is EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER and rollback restores the sealed enforcement baseline without deleting history.

release_requirements.required_receipt: Full phase-chain verifier, adversarial tests, correct origin, correct rollback, clean exact candidate, and authenticated empty target.

stop_conditions: Any minimal or tampered receipt still passes.
